feature: The trade-match press on Home's What's new and /friends' Waiting on you: Ask {friend} with spare requests on (d9, 2026-10-27). From desktop the time and the press share one line at the right of both rows (Hugh's ruling 2026-10-27, the menu-home plan's product call 5)
note: Needs SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED on, on a SCRATCH branch seeded with a friend who shares a wishlist card as a spare with a pod the reader is in, and every feed kind on for the reader (enabled 30 days back, so new sets arrive). Visit /friends once first: it notices the trade matches after its response. Read-only: nothing is pressed.
